listing.name: Blade II: The Return of Evil (blade2-mobile)
listing.summary: An experimental Blade II-specific Apple ARM64 native-code and Horizon/NVN-to-Metal compatibility project. The project reports Mac levels 1–3 and the first boss at 60 FPS, with audio, cutscenes, controllers and saving; these are its own limited observations. iOS has not been run on a physical device, although its ARM64 shell compiles. There is no observed release package or Windows/Linux route. Local extract_game.sh, patch_nso for sdk/subsdk0/main, shader preparation and mac_app_blade.sh generate an app/DMG. Use your own XCI and prod.keys or extracted ExeFS/RomFS. The example is title 01009cc00e224000 with update v131072; the exact accepted range is unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
